lessons.title: You are a business owner, not a YouTuber
lessons.hook: Your channel can be taken away overnight. Your email list cannot.

points: Rented land versus owned land
Views, subscribers and fame are not the goal; leads are
Ad revenue is a bonus, not a business

Every video sends viewers to one place: your list
